question: Iterate the copy-lane measurement until angular2-hn's lane either builds GREEN under the provisioned Node 16.20.2 or hits a wall that is NOT an adapter-written value. What is the exact list of ungated adapter rewrites standing between authorization and a building Angular lane?
answer: The enumeration is COMPLETE and it terminated GREEN. Exactly TWO ungated adapter rewrites stand between authorization and a building Angular lane for this app. Both are unconditional modern-line rewrites in the frozen Angular adapter. With both reverted to the values the era app declared - and nothing else touched - angular2-hn builds clean under Node 16.20.2 in 5.3s and emits a 28-file output directory with index.html at its root, satisfying the witness contract's input.

It is also inert at target es2015 - TypeScript's default for useDefineForClassFields is false below ES2022 - so leaving it in place cannot have contributed to the green result.

theCompletePrice.statement: The exact list of ungated adapter rewrites standing between authorization and a building Angular lane for angular2-hn is TWO items long, and it is now closed by measurement rather than by inference.

theCompletePrice.sufficiency: Gating these two - and only these two - is NECESSARY AND SUFFICIENT for a green angular2-hn build under the provisioned cell. u1b could only establish necessity and prove insufficiency of the first alone; this unit establishes the sufficiency of the pair.
theCompletePrice.meaningForRiskR1: R1 (frozen-subtree reopen) is confirmed unavoidable and confirmed BOUNDED. Both gates live in one frozen file. One reopen of that file, two conditionals, closes the whole distance for this app. The scope the owner is being asked to authorize is now a measured quantity, not an open-ended one.
theCompletePrice.meaningForU2AsScoped: u2 as originally scoped (gate the polyfills rewrite only) is necessary but not sufficient - u1b proved that. This unit proves the missing piece is exactly one more gate in the same file, not an unbounded chain.

verdict.honestCellRestated: Node 16.20.2 plus the lane's own offline closure compiles, bundles, optimizes and emits this entire application in 5.3 seconds. Every wall the enumeration found was a value the pipeline wrote, and none was a limit of the runtime, of the app, or of the host. The cell was never the problem.
verdict.scopeOfThisClaim: One application - angular2-hn, the 13-cell lane. Whether other Angular apps in the fleet hit additional ungated rewrites past these two is NOT established here; this unit enumerated one lane to its end. The two rewrites found are workspace-level and cell-independent in their ungatedness, so they will fire for every 13-line app, but a different app may exercise a rewrite this one does not.
